{{Quote|Hi, Dad. I'm back. Here's the evening faxsplat. By the way, feel free to ask me to run errands for you any time you want &hellip;|Prestor|<ref name="GFT" />}}
'''Prestor''' was a young man whose [[Parent/Legends|father]] owned a [[Hyperfoil 1000-XTC]]. Prestor took the [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] out to collect the evening [[faxsplat]] for his father, enjoying the ride by playing tag with [[Dorqweull]] and trying to impress young women who were on their rooftops.<ref name="GFT" />
